description: This file contains the server-side logic for a web page used to set up multiple-choice questions (MCQ) exams within an online examination system. It includes event handlers for page actions such as selecting courses, adding questions, setting exams, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQ set-up web page, handling question and exam creation, course selection, and navigation within the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initial page load handler, currently commented out, potentially for initializing session variables.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown list based on the selected semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields related to question and exam setup.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new MCQ question to the database, updates question number, and notifies the user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up an exam for the selected course by updating the database, then transfers to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown list based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the question number based on the selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the LoginPage.
